title: IMD Mausam App & 5-Day Weather Forecast for Farmers
target_audience: Farmers, outdoor workers, and general public planning agricultural or travel activities.
benefits: Real-time temperature, humidity, rainfall probability, wind speed, and color-coded alerts (Green, Yellow, Orange, Red) from India Meteorological Department.
how_to_apply: Download 'Mausam' app by Ministry of Earth Sciences or check mausam.imd.gov.in for district-wise agro-meteorological advisories.

title: Damini App for Lightning Strike Alert & Thunderstorm Safety
target_audience: Farmers, construction workers, and rural residents working in open fields during monsoon and pre-monsoon.
benefits: Gives advance warning of cloud-to-ground lightning strikes within 20 to 40 km radius 30-45 minutes before impact, saving lives.
how_to_apply: Download 'Damini' app from Google Play Store. When lightning warning alerts, avoid standing under tall trees or near electric poles; take shelter inside pucca building.

title: Heatwave & Loo Wave Protection Guidelines (NDMA)
target_audience: Laborers, elderly citizens, children, and farm workers during summer months (March - June).
benefits: Critical preventive steps: Drink plenty of water, ORS, buttermilk (Chhaas), coconut water; wear loose light-colored cotton clothes; avoid heavy direct sun between 12 PM - 3 PM; carry wet cloth over head.
eligibility: All individuals during high summer temperature periods.
how_to_apply: If heatstroke symptoms occur (high body temperature, dizziness, nausea, dry skin), immediately move patient to shade, apply ice/cool water to neck and armpits, and rush to hospital.

title: Monsoon Flood Safety & Evacuation Protocols
target_audience: Communities residing near riverbanks, low-lying coastal areas, or flood-prone plains.
benefits: Life safety instructions: Keep emergency go-bag ready with drinking water, dry food, torch, batteries, essential medicines, and waterproof polythene for Aadhaar/property papers; move to elevated relief shelters before roads submerge.
documents_needed: Carry ID and land documents in waterproof pouch.
how_to_apply: Never attempt to walk, swim, or drive through moving floodwaters. Disconnect main electrical power MCB before water enters home. Dial 1070/1078 for NDRF boat rescue.

title: Cyclone Warning Flags & Coastal Protection Rules
target_audience: Fishermen, coastal residents, and maritime workers along Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal.
benefits: Understanding IMD cyclone stages (Pre-Cyclone Watch, Cyclone Alert 48 hrs before, Cyclone Warning 24 hrs before, Landfall Outlook). Strict prohibition on venturing into rough seas.
how_to_apply: Secure boat anchors, trim tree branches near houses, board up window glass, stock clean drinking water, and evacuate to Cyclone Shelters upon administration orders.

title: Earthquake Emergency Protocol: Drop, Cover, and Hold On
benefits: Golden safety rules during tremor: Do NOT run outside into falling debris or use elevators. Drop to hands and knees, take Cover under a sturdy table/bed, and Hold On until shaking stops.
how_to_apply: If outdoors, move away from buildings, power cables, and flyovers into an open ground. Check for gas leaks and fire hazards after tremors cease.

title: Meghdoot App for District Crop-Weather Integration
target_audience: Farmers making decisions on pesticide spraying, fertilizer application, harvesting, and irrigation.
benefits: Combines IMD 5-day weather forecasts directly with ICAR agricultural advisory, warning when NOT to spray pesticides before rainfall to prevent chemical wash-off and wastage.
how_to_apply: Download 'Meghdoot' app developed by ICAR, IITM, and IMD; select your district and crop for customized weekly farm advisory.

title: Cold Wave & Frost (Pala) Protection for Winter Rabi Crops
target_audience: Farmers growing potato, mustard, tomato, and vegetables during severe December-January winter.
benefits: Protection measures against freezing frost injury: Light night irrigation, smoking (dhuwan) on field borders along wind direction, and spray of 0.1% Commercial Sulfuric Acid or Soluble Sulfur (2g/L).
eligibility: Vegetable and crop growers in North & Central India.
how_to_apply: Monitor nighttime temperature dip below 4°C with calm winds; initiate light irrigation before midnight to raise soil temperature.

title: CAP SACHET National Early Disaster Warning Portal & SMS
target_audience: Citizens across all states receiving geo-targeted emergency warning alerts.
benefits: Targeted wireless SMS and siren alerts directly from State Disaster Management Authorities (SDMA) during extreme weather emergencies without needing internet connectivity.
eligibility: All mobile phone users with active network signal.
how_to_apply: Read official emergency broadcast notifications carefully on phone and follow instructions issued by District Magistrate.

title: Landslide Safety Guidelines for Hilly Roads & Highways
target_audience: Residents and travelers in Himalayan and Western Ghats mountain regions during monsoon.
benefits: Recognizing landslide warning signs (sudden muddiness in spring water, leaning trees, rock falls) and maintaining emergency distance on Ghat roads.
eligibility: Travelers and inhabitants of hilly terrains.
how_to_apply: Check highway transit status with local traffic police control room before traveling in torrential rain; never stop vehicles near steep loose cliff sides.
